title: Coverage Cat | AI-native insurance brokerage
excerpt: Coverage Cat is an AI-native insurance broker for high-earning households. Compare home, umbrella, auto, and renters options online, or integrate the Coverage Cat Agent API.
content_html:
Coverage Cat Insurance

Compare & Shop

Home & umbrella coverage with a licensed broker. Built around price transparency, privacy, and speed. Shop in our portal, or just connect your agent.

Licensed insurance broker No sold leads Tens of thousands of users served

Agents: start with /.well-known/mcp.json.

  • Cold-start umbrella tool: umbrella_consumer_prefill
  • Compatible browser agents can call the umbrella consumer subset directly from this page.
  • Machine brief: /?mode=agent
  • Plain-text discovery: /agents.txt, /.well-known/agents.txt
  • Docs fallback: /developers/mcp, /api/agent, /llms.txt
  • Do not drive the browser UI unless Coverage Cat should take over the shopper-facing flow.

Shop with context

Smart tools to make the right decisions

The new way to shop for insurance

Our agents find the best policies for users, even when we don't make commission on them.

How it works

Coverage Cat is a licensed insurance brokerage that helps you compare home, umbrella, auto, and renters coverage side by side — with straight pricing, no sold leads, and a real broker on the other end.

Ask a question or start a comparison. Coverage Cat pairs AI-guided intake with a licensed brokerage team, so you can size up coverage, see honest price ranges, and compare real carrier options without handing your details to five agents overnight. Developers can drive the same flow through the Agent API.

Where we operate

Coverage Cat is live for shoppers in California, Florida, New York, Texas, and Washington, with more states on the way.

Product surfaces

  • Learn: What we do, FAQ, and insurance guides
  • Estimate: Home insurance calculator, umbrella insurance calculator, carrier price comparison, and file-a-claim guidance
  • Compare: Start a Coverage Cat quote comparison
  • Integrate: Coverage Cat Agent API hub, developer portal, get API key guide, discovery JSON, OpenAPI, and skill markdown

Key links

  • Get API key guide
